summary: Security fix: under channelBinding=require, fails the SCRAM connection when no tls-server-end-point hash can be derived from the server certificate (e.g. Ed25519) and when the negotiated mechanism is not -PLUS, instead of silently downgrading.

tests.evidence: Regression test covers the Ed25519 path, but the authoritative post-negotiation isPlus check has no test (Codecov: 18% patch coverage, 9 lines missed) and requireRejectsConnectionWithoutSsl only re-tests pre-existing behaviour.

user_docs.evidence: README/use.md already say require 'must employ channel binding'; the fix brings code in line, only an optional note on unsupported certificate algorithms.

doc_comments.evidence: Inline comments explain the fail-closed reasoning and match the code; test class Javadoc names the advisory.

change_description.evidence: Security fix (GHSA-j92g-9f8w-j867) with no CHANGELOG.md entry although 42.7.12 has an empty '### Security' heading; entries were added in later docs commits on master.

security.evidence: Changes SCRAM channel-binding enforcement (authentication downgrade); fail-closed logic in ScramAuthenticator.java needs a focused check.

backward_compat.evidence: Connections with channelBinding=require to Ed25519-certificate servers that previously (insecurely) succeeded now fail; intended per the advisory.

concurrency.evidence: No shared state or resources touched.

error_model.evidence: Adds two CONNECTION_REJECTED PSQLExceptions with new messages; they escape the narrower catch blocks correctly and the message names the algorithm and remediation.

correctness.evidence: Small conditional logic; the main risk is covered by the security axis.

surprising_behavior.evidence: require now fails where it used to connect, which is what users of require expect.

contradictions.evidence: Description matches the code; existing advertisedMechanisms check left as described.

build_ci.evidence: Deliberately keeps scram-client 3.2; no dependency or build change.

observability.evidence: Failures surface as exceptions to the caller; no silent path added.

spec_conformance.evidence: Interprets RFC 5929 tls-server-end-point (no defined hash for Ed25519) and SCRAM -PLUS negotiation semantics.

plan.why: A small, security-focused change in one class; one reviewer covers enforcement, errors, spec, and tests together.
